title: Edge-grain cutting board
desc: Glue up strips of maple or walnut, flatten, sand and finish with food-safe mineral oil.

title: Bench hook and shooting board
desc: Two simple jigs that make hand sawing and trimming ends square much easier. Good first projects.

title: Simple step stool
desc: A sturdy stool with angled sides. Practise accurate crosscuts and a strong joint.

title: Dovetailed keepsake box
desc: Cut through dovetails by hand at the four corners. Expect the second box to look much better than the first.

title: French cleat tool wall
desc: Rip plywood strips at 45 degrees and hang them on the wall, then build holders that can be rearranged at any time.
